brief:
Israeli forces carried out demolition operations Saturday in an area east of Qarara, north of Khan Younis in southern Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The demolitions mark the latest in a series of military actions by Israeli troops operating within Gaza.

The operations continue as Israeli military activity persists across the territory. No further details about the scope or purpose of the demolition work were immediately available.
